practice_questions.question_text: Discuss one ethical challenge when an ML content-recommendation service replicates users’ creative work across independently managed servers for its training dataset.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
practice_questions.solution: Replication makes training data available across several servers, but copies may spread beyond the creator’s intended purpose or consent. Attribution or deletion requests may not propagate uniformly. Operators need clear consent, attribution and removal practices; decentralization alone does not resolve creators’ rights.

practice_questions.question_text: Discuss one benefit and one limitation of combining measurements from many distributed weather stations instead of depending on one station.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
practice_questions.solution: Many locations provide wider geographical coverage and can reveal local differences. However, uneven sensor quality or network failures may make readings inconsistent or unavailable. Calibration and validation are needed before combining data; more sources do not automatically guarantee accuracy.

practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
practice_questions.solution: The class defines the attributes and methods shared by reservations. An object is one concrete instance with its own state, such as one customer’s dates and rate. Many objects can be created from the same definition.
